title: AD Class 8 Mathematics — Chapter 1: Rational Numbers (Complete 75 Textbook Exercises)

questions.q: Fill in the blank using Commutative Property of Addition: (-3/7) + (4/9) = _____ + (-3/7)
questions.m: Altering the sign or value of an addend when applying the commutative property.

opts.m: Changed the sign of the addend; commutativity only swaps position, not sign.
Replaced the unknown with the first term rather than the second addend.
Subtracted the fractions instead of applying the order-reversal property.

hints.h1: Look at the two addends on the left-hand side.
hints.h2: The Commutative Property of Addition states that a + b equals b + a.
hints.h3: Match the terms: if the first term moves to the second spot, the second moves to the first.
hints.h4: Identify which of the two original terms is missing on the right side.

questions.q: Fill in the blank using Commutative Property of Addition: (2/3) + (-5/6) = (-5/6) + _____
questions.m: Changing the sign of a term when moving its position.

opts.m: Flipped the sign of the rational addend when changing its order.

questions.q: Fill in the blank using Commutative Property of Addition: [(-11/29)] + [(-5/31)] = [(-5/31)] + _____

questions.q: Fill in the blank using Commutative Property of Addition: (-7/13) + (11/23) = (11/23) + _____

questions.m: Inverting or dropping the sign of a factor in a commutative product.

questions.m: Confusing multiplicative identity (1) with additive identity (0) or reciprocal.

opts.m: Multiplying by zero produces zero, not the original number.

questions.m: Confusing the zero property of multiplication with the multiplicative inverse.

opts.m: Multiplying by one preserves the number rather than reducing it to zero.

questions.m: Misunderstanding which terms are distributed in a(b + c) = ab + ac.

questions.m: Changing signs or picking the wrong term when regrouping under associativity.

questions.q: Complete the statement: The product of two rational numbers is always a _______
questions.m: Assuming rational multiplication always simplifies to integers or whole numbers.

questions.q: Fill in the blank using Associative Property of Addition: [(1/11) + (2/13)] + (7/6) = (1/11) + [_____ + (7/6)]
